name.ja: Bトレインショーティー 伊豆箱根鉄道3000系　ラブライブ！サンシャイン!! ラッピング電車　HAPPY PARTY TRAIN 3
name.en: B Train Shorty Izu Hakone Railway 3000 Series Love Live! Sunshine!! Wrapping train HAPPY PARTY TRAIN 3

description.ja: 2017年に運行し大好評を博したラッピング電車第１弾に引き続き、３rd シングル「HAPPY PARTY TRAIN」の発売（４月５日）に合わせて、フルラッピングで運行された伊豆箱根鉄道3000系がBトレに登場！
description.en: Following the first wrapped train that was operated in 2017 and received great acclaim, the Izu Hakone Railway 3000 series, which was operated in full wrapping, is now available in B-Train in conjunction with the release of the 3rd single "HAPPY PARTY TRAIN" (45)!

description.ja: 先頭車前面に貼れるヘッドマークステッカー全10種付き！
description.en: Comes with 10 types of head mark stickers that can be pasted on the front of the lead car!

description.ja: 2年生の美麗イラストが入った3号車クモハ3011です！
description.en: 3rd car Kumoha 3011 with beautiful illustrations of 2nd graders!
